decisive_nonpass.reason: large connected cyan lateral shelf or lobe with a narrow neck in both XY and XZ, inconsistent with one coherent central cap

corroborating_nonpass_seen_during_concur.reason: large connected cyan lateral lobe or prong with a neck and concavity in both XY and XZ
corroborating_nonpass_seen_during_concur.decision_role: corroboration_only; the first recorded nonpass already stopped the experiment

concurrent_review_disclosure.reason: AI assessments of eye samples ran concurrently, so additional already-rendered cases were seen before the global stop propagated.
concurrent_review_disclosure.decision_basis: Only one nonpass was required. The decisive case and one corroborating case each received two concordant AI visual assessments under the frozen criterion; these were not independent human or anatomical-expert reviews. The remaining first-pass AI flags are unadjudicated workflow telemetry and are not used to estimate a failure rate.

visual_exposure_ledger.future_use_rule: All rendered identities are treated as viewed development cases even if their review was interrupted.

interpretation: At least one automatically eligible sampled core violated the prespecified visual-coherence criterion, so the frozen robust-cap extraction and automatic gates did not guarantee that criterion and Experiment 64 was ineligible for scoring. It produced no result about distal shape descriptors versus the nested position-and-scale control.
